entries.clue: Coarse grassy plant with three-sided stems, growing in soggy ground
Boulder-strewn white stretch where a river turns rough and loud
Grey statue in the shallows that waits, stabs, and swallows the fish whole
Round of paper, one side inked over, served as a pirate crew's formal notice
A chick's wide-open mouth, yellow-rimmed and begging to be filled
Water spreading over fields when a river tops its banks; Noah knew one
Fence of pointed logs thrown round a hut, held by the loyal party under fire
Sheltered nick in a coastline where a boat can slip ashore unseen
Drab hedge-skulker with a thin bill and grey head, once called a sparrow
Geordie river with a great arched bridge and a song about fog on it
Dump a man on an empty islet and sail off; also a deep brownish red
Long-tailed black-and-white crow, all chattering rattle; one for sorrow, two for joy
